title: Database Design
description: Learn how to leverage Claude to transform complex business requirements into optimized SQL schemas and production-ready migration scripts.
learning_objectives: Translate business requirements into a logical data model using AI prompts
Generate normalized SQL DDL for relational databases
Optimize database performance through AI-suggested indexing strategies
Create versioned migration scripts for schema evolution
prerequisites: Basic knowledge of SQL and relational database concepts

sections.heading: From Business Logic to Logical Schema
sections.content_brief: Explain how to provide Claude with a detailed business scenario to generate an Entity-Relationship (ER) description. Focus on defining entities, attributes, and the nature of relationships (1:1, 1:N, N:M).
sections.code_context: A high-quality prompt that describes a complex business domain (e.g., an e-commerce marketplace) to elicit a structured data model.

sections.heading: Generating Normalized SQL DDL
sections.content_brief: Demonstrate how to convert the logical model into physical SQL Data Definition Language (DDL). Cover prompting for specific database dialects (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) and ensuring 3rd Normal Form (3NF).
sections.code_context: A complete SQL schema including tables, primary keys, foreign keys, and constraints generated by Claude.

sections.heading: AI-Driven Performance Optimization
sections.content_brief: Show how to prompt Claude to analyze the schema against specific query patterns. Focus on generating optimized indexes, choosing appropriate data types for scale, and implementing partitioning strategies.
sections.code_context: SQL statements for creating B-tree or GIN indexes based on AI analysis of expected read/write workloads.

sections.heading: Automating Schema Migrations
sections.content_brief: Guide the user through generating 'Up' and 'Down' migration scripts to evolve an existing schema. Explain how to prompt Claude to handle data preservation during column renames or type changes.
sections.code_context: A versioned migration script that adds a new feature to the database while maintaining backward compatibility.

admonitions.content: AI may occasionally suggest SQL syntax that is generic or slightly incompatible with your specific database version. Always validate the generated DDL in a staging environment before applying it to production.

When asking for optimizations, provide Claude with actual example queries you expect to run frequently; this allows the AI to suggest indexes based on real-world usage rather than theoretical patterns.
